body:
Quick pass on head `3fe7da701`: PR #2138 is merged (`dab6498ae`), thus this PR shows only its own change against `main`. The two pinning tests in `stale_rapid_law.rs`, `wire_stamp`, `first_router_part`, `clearance_in_stock` and clippy on `camcraft-app` are green. The quick gate ran one time; only `wire_stamp` was red, and it is fixed.

I flag the PR ready for the independent review. The review is under the safety floor. This PR is the fix of a `P1` and is permitted during the merge stop.

Note for the release notes: each saved operation shows as out of date one time after the upgrade and must be regenerated before a post.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3fe7da701880d0cf837095320c3d1fabce9cf22d -->

Verdict: clean. Ready for a maintainer to merge.

Trial merge: merged into main at dab6498ae (#2138 head e7050be17 is already in main). The merge of 3fe7da701 into it is clean, no conflicts. Landing delta is 6 files, 1081 insertions, 5 deletions. The large sim/verify code in the diff view came from #2138, not this branch. Built locally.

Suites run (merged tree, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4, sccache, debug):
- stale_rapid_law: 2 passed, 0 failed
- wire_stamp: 7 passed, 0 failed
- first_router_part: 4 passed, 0 failed
- app lib stamp units: 13 passed, 0 failed
- clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean

1. The fixture is a real old-law cache. Its first cached move is a lateral rapid from Z 8 to Z 8, under a Z 10 stock top. Its cache carries zero verdicts (`"warnings": []`). Its stored stamp 15219314806647839544 was made with the v2 salt. The pin asserts that it reads Stale, that the post refuses it, and that a refused post writes no file. The author shows the pre-bump read was Ok. A green run confirms the read is Stale now.

2. No path posts on a stale stamp. current_stamp seeds one DefaultHasher with the salt first. Every writer appends into that same hasher: the tool arm, the wire EDM arm through stamp_condition(&mut h), and the sinker arms. No branch starts a fresh hasher, so none bypasses the salt. program_ops (posting.rs:668) checks status_of per op and returns an error on Stale before it builds any record. Every byte-writing entry funnels there: post_setup, post_script and post_setup_unwritten go through post_script_body to op_streams_by; post_mounts and post_mounts_script take the single-mount arm to post_setup, or the multi-mount arm through post_each to op_streams_by; post_per_op goes through op_streams. The MCP post tool, the CLI -o verb and the script verb post all reach v_post, which calls post_mounts. commands/post.rs is SelectPost only: it sets the script and writes no program. The pin exercises this gate through post_setup and post_setup_unwritten.

3. The three example stamps. Each of the three new digests in examples/first-router-part.camproj differs from its old value because the salt prefix moved from v2 to v3. The same inputs run through a different seeded state, so each digest changes. first_router_part_project_loads_verifies_and_posts_to_grblhal passed, which loads the example and posts it: it reads fresh under v3, not Stale. The wire and sinker branches are covered too: the 7 wire_stamp tests pass with the re-pinned ONE_PROFILE_STAMP, and op_stamp adds only an area term on top of the current_stamp base. The other recorded projects keep their old stamps and regenerate once.

4. One-time churn, not recurring. The stamp is saved as a raw digest (OperationDto.stamp). Load does not recompute it and applies no stamp migration. status_of compares the saved value with the recomputed v3 digest. A v2 cache reads Stale once. A regenerate stores the v3 digest, so a save and reload reads Ok. There is no double bump. The example test and regenerating_the_old_cache_judges_it_under_the_new_law prove both directions.

5. Project laws. The decision file docs/decisions/2152-stale-rapid-verdict.md follows the README format and states the salt change. The changed source adds no unwrap, expect or panic; the only src change is the salt line and a comment in stamp.rs (364 lines). CHANGELOG.md is untouched on the branch. The PR body has a Changelog: line and ends with the Fixes #2152 line. No snapshot PNG changed. No new dependency, no build.rs, and no .github change, so this is not a needs-maintainer case. The Stale message "inputs moved since generation - regenerate before posting" is plain English and names regenerate.

Note, not blocking: This change avoids a project-version bump, so older builds can still open these files.

Skipped: the full batch and release tiers, and the other camcraft-app suites. The author ran 31 app suites and the app lib at quick. The UI suites were not run, because the source delta does not touch UI posting code. clearance_in_stock was not re-run; its code came from #2138 and is already on main.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
